title: LEVEL 3 Diploma in Computing
description: An entry-level foundation program introducing essential computing, mathematics, programming, and study skills.

title: Level 4 Diploma in Computing
description: Equivalent to the first year of a UK bachelor's degree, covering core software engineering, databases, networking, and algorithms.

title: Level 4 Diploma in Computing with Business Management
description: Combines core Level 4 computing skills with essential business, management, and eBusiness principles.

title: Level 5 Diploma in Computing
description: Equivalent to the second year of a UK bachelor's degree, focusing on advanced topics like AI, cybersecurity, mobile dev, and agile project delivery.

title: Level 5 Diploma in Computing with Business Management
description: Advanced technical training paired with business operations, information systems management, and enterprise IT strategy.
